digest.component_or_area: Cloud Jira adapter resilience and config validation
propositions: Cloud lacks per-member 429 sweep coverage that DC has; every mutating transport member must be enumerated and classified by transport seam (ACLI subprocess/pooled REST/bare urlopen) and dispatch level (retrying wrapper/non-retrying phases/no wrapper)
Cloud has no config-validation tests for non-HTTPS URL rejection, missing credential handling, or workflow-customizable resolved statuses, whereas DC validates these
Cloud's probe.py hardcodes resolved-status names whereas DC reads them from settings; decision required on whether Cloud deployments with non-standard workflow states need a runtime config hook
DC lacks assertion that search_user_by_email degradation occurs when methods are absent; Cloud and DC surfaces differ and accidental rename on Cloud side would be silent

Mutations traversing Cloud's four distinct 429 behaviours across two levels (direct REST/subprocess/retrying dispatch wrapper/non-retrying apply phases) require per-layer boundary assertion, not uniform attempt-count pin

Every intentional retry (rate-limit backoff in _run_acli, 429 branch in _call_with_retry) must have duplicate-write safety assessed and recorded in repo artifact, distinguishing them from undocumented retry paths
